info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Edenitec Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Edenitec Laptop Details API allows users to create and manage detailed information about Edenitec laptop products within the catalog. This endpoint enables the submission of comprehensive specifications, features, and pricing information, enhancing the availability of rich product data. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that aim to provide detailed product offerings to customers. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure accurate representation of their laptop inventory, streamlining sales and marketing efforts.

post.description: This operation allows you to create new details for an Edenitec laptop. You can provide various parameters that will help in defining the specifications and attributes of the laptop.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details about an Edenitec laptop. This includes various specifications and attributes that define the laptop's characteristics.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the laptop details.
